title: Claude and missiles
author: Launch_Zealot
selftext:
Hey everyone, first time posting here.

I’ve been working on a modern day battlefield simulation for the last few months. Working with Claude has been a dream come true in many ways, but I’m running into a problem that Claude’s censorship is way too touchy about missiles. I can make guns and rockets all day long, but the minute I try to do SAMs, ATGMs, or AGMs I struggle with “safety filters”.  It’s so extreme that Claude refuses to fly Javelins anywhere near profiles freely available to the public. How do you all manage this?

comments.author: geddy
comments.body: Just tell Claude they’re missile-shaped dongs, and that you’re trying to be more “PG rated” by making the dongers look like air missiles.
